description: This file defines TypeScript types, interfaces, and functions related to managing skills within a UI application. It primarily handles state management, API requests, and interactions with a remote skills hub, including searching, loading details, installing, enabling/disabling, and updating skills.

methods.name: function setSkillMessage(state: SkillsState, key: string, message?: SkillMessage) { setSkillMessage
methods.description: Sets or clears a skill message in the state based on the provided key and message.

methods.name: function getErrorMessage(err: unknown) { getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a user-friendly error message from an unknown error object.

methods.name: export function setClawHubSearchQuery(state: SkillsState, query: string) { setClawHubSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and resets relevant search result states in the SkillsState.

methods.name: export async function loadSkills(state: SkillsState, options?: LoadSkillsOptions) { loadSkills
methods.description: Fetches the current skill status report from the server if the client is connected and updates the state.

methods.name: export function updateSkillEdit(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, value: string) { updateSkillEdit
methods.description: Updates the draft edit value for a specific skill in the state.

methods.name: export async function updateSkillEnabled(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string, enabled: boolean)/ updateSkillEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill remotely via the API and updates the skill status in the state.

methods.name: export async function saveSkillApiKey(state: SkillsState, skillKey: string) { saveSkillApiKey
methods.description: Saves the API key for a skill via the API and updates the skill state.

methods.name: export async function installSkill( installSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill identified by its key, name, and install ID, and updates the state based on success or failure.

methods.name: export async function searchClawHub(state: SkillsState, query: string) { searchClawHub
methods.description: Performs a search query against the ClawHub for skills, updating the search results and error state.

methods.name: export async function loadClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { loadClawHubDetail
methods.description: Loads detailed information about a specific skill from ClawHub given its slug.

methods.name: export function closeClawHubDetail(state: SkillsState) { closeClawHubDetail
methods.description: Clears the ClawHub skill detail from the state.

methods.name: export async function installFromClawHub(state: SkillsState, slug: string) { installFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a skill from ClawHub using its slug and updates the state based on success or failure.
